collection.title: VW Transporter T5 2013 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Transporter T5 2013 to 2015 model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Transporter T5, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
